Specification: A machine-checked proof of safety and liveness for a Grow-only Counter (G-Counter) CRDT. It formally verifies the TypeOK invariant, monotonicity of the state transitions, and global convergence to a consistent count using a measure-based termination argument in the TLA+ Proof System (TLAPS).
TheoremNames: LEMMA SumType == ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat] PROVE Sum(f) \in Nat PROOF OMITTED
LEMMA SumIsZero == ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat] PROVE Sum(f) = 0 <=> \A x \in Node : f[x] = 0 PROOF OMITTED
LEMMA SumWeaklyMonotonic == ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat], NEW g \in [Node -> Nat], \A x \in Node : f[x] <= g[x] PROVE Sum(f) <= Sum(g) PROOF OMITTED
LEMMA SumStronglyMonotonic == ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat], NEW g \in [Node -> Nat], \A x \in Node : f[x] <= g[x], \E x \in Node : f[x] < g[x] PROVE Sum(f) < Sum(g) PROOF OMITTED
LEMMA EnabledGossip == ASSUME NEW n \in Node, NEW o \in Node, TypeOK PROVE (ENABLED <<Gossip(n,o)>>_vars) <=> \E v \in Node : counter[o][v] < counter[n][v]
LEMMA MeasureType == ASSUME TypeOK, Safety PROVE /\ \A o \in Node : DistFun(o) \in [Node -> Nat] /\ \A o \in Node : Distance(o) \in Nat /\ Measure \in Nat
LEMMA MeasureTypePrime == ASSUME TypeOK', Safety' PROVE /\ \A o \in Node : DistFun(o)' \in [Node -> Nat] /\ \A o \in Node : Distance(o)' \in Nat /\ Measure' \in Nat

LEMMA MeasureIsZero == ASSUME TypeOK, Safety PROVE /\ \A o \in Node : Distance(o) = 0 <=> \A n \in Node : counter[o][n] = counter[n][n] /\ Measure = 0 <=> \A v,w,n \in Node : counter[v][n] = counter[w][n]

LEMMA GossipDoesntIncreaseMeasure == ASSUME TypeOK, TypeOK', Safety, Safety', [\E n,o \in Node : Gossip(n,o)]_vars PROVE /\ \A v,w \in Node : DistFun(v)'[w] <= DistFun(v)[w] /\ \A v \in Node : Distance(v)' <= Distance(v) /\ Measure' <= Measure
LEMMA GossipDecreasesMeasure == ASSUME TypeOK, TypeOK', Safety, Safety', <<\E n,o \in Node : Gossip(n,o)>>_vars PROVE Measure' < Measure
THEOREM OGLiveness == OGSpec => <>(\A n, o \in Node : counter[n] = counter[o])
